title: DataRow

contact_id.description: ID of the contact this row is associated with (or null if not associated with any contact)

from_number.description: Phone number that this row is associated with (or null if not associated with any phone number)

vars.description:
Custom variables stored for this data row. Variable names may be up to 32 characters in length and can contain the characters a-z, A-Z, 0-9, and _.
 Values may be strings, numbers, or boolean (true/false).
 String values may be up to 4096 bytes in length when encoded as UTF-8.
 Up to 100 variables are supported per object.
 Setting a variable to null will delete the variable.

time_created.description: The time this row was created in Telerivet

time_updated.description: The time this row was last updated in Telerivet

table_id.description: ID of the table this data row belongs to

project_id.description: ID of the project this data row belongs to

description:
Represents a row in a custom data table.

 For example, each response to a poll is stored as one row in a data table. If a poll has a question with ID 'q1', the verbatim response to that question would be stored in {sigil}row{dot}vars{dot}q1, and the response code would be stored in {sigil}row{dot}vars{dot}q1_code.

 Each custom variable name within a data row corresponds to a different column/field of the data table.
